newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Kin Yat public offering 523 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Kin Yat public offering 523 times subscribed.

text.p: Remote control toy car manufacturer Kin Yat Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday its initial public offering of shares in Hong Kong was 523 times subscribed.
Kin Yat offered 85 million shares at HK$1.28 per share, of which 76.5 million were for public offering in Hong Kong.
The Hong Kong-based toy car manufacturer company said in a statement that dealing in the shares would begin on May 1.
The net proceeds of HK$96.8 million would be used in acquiring new plant and machinery for two new production facilities located in south China city of Shenzhen and Shaoguan, it said.
